method: Reconstruct compatible positive private-hand pairs from BOTH raw reach vectors; marginalize or condition before 169-cell aggregation. Compare each action edge with parent joint mass times the actual exported actor policy.
knownLimitations: Only the existing two tiny locked river models.
No chance-node or folded-player bunching support verified by this adapter.
No full-range requested flop strategy, no equilibrium quality claim, no NL50 or learner result.
A zero-reference branch may still be a legal real action; requires a new reference to continue, never call it a learner legality error.
